figkit gallery

Every panel below is rendered from synthetic data by demo/gallery.py — no private inputs. Find the one that looks like what you need and copy its call.

theme: avm18 panel typespython + R

Python — matplotlib

01Volcano

Differential expression: effect size vs significance.

volcano(de, ax, x_col="log2FoldChange", y_col="pvalue",
        lfc_thresh=0.8, p_thresh=0.01, top_n_labels=12,
        exclude_patterns=NOISE_GENE_PATTERNS + CONTROL_PROBE_PATTERNS)

02Pathway dotplot

Enrichment: x/colour = NES, size = FDR.

dotplot_pathway(gsea, ax, top_n=18, sort_by="signed")

03Expression dotplot

Gene × group: colour = mean expression, size = % expressing.

mean_df, pct_df = expression_matrix(adata, genes, "pole")
dotplot_expression(mean_df, pct_df, ax, dividers=[9.5],
                   block_labels=[(4.5, "up", UP), (14.5, "down", DN)])

04UMAP — categorical

Embedding coloured by cell type.

embedding_categorical(ax, xy, obs["label"], palette=pal,
                      point_size=1.6, legend_title="Cell type")

05UMAP — continuous

Embedding coloured by a score.

embedding_continuous(ax, xy, obs["score"],
                     norm=quantile_norm(obs["score"], .02, .98),
                     cbar_label="signature score")

06UMAP — highlight

Grey backdrop + highlighted subset.

highlight_mask(ax, xy, mask, fg_size=6, bg_size=1.2,
               label=f"variant+ (n={mask.sum()})")

07Spatial map

Tissue coordinates in mm, with scale bar.

embedding_continuous(ax, xy, obs["score"], point_size=3.5)
add_scale_bar(ax, length=0.5, unit="mm")

08Heatmap

Signed matrix; diverging scale centred on zero.

heatmap(m, ax, symmetric=True, cbar_label="signed score",
        col_label_rotation=45)

09Lollipop

Signed per-feature effect; size = −log10 q.

lollipop(tf, ax, label_col="source", value_col="delta",
         q_col="q", top_n=24)

10Stacked bar

Composition per sample, normalised.

stacked_bar(comp, ax, palette=pal, legend_title="Cell type")

11Ordered bar

One statistic per category, in a fixed order.

ordered_bar(df, ax, value_col="pct_variant", order=AV_ORDER,
            palette=theme.palette("ec_subtype"))

12Chord (signed)

Interaction Δ; needs pycirclize.

not rendered — optional dependency missing (see README)
chord_signed(m, "panels/chord", top_n_per_sign=14)

13UpSet

Set intersections across modalities.

upset(sets, "panels/upset", min_subset_size=1)

R — ggplot2 (no Python twin)

Clinical panels ported from the genotype-phenotype manuscript pipeline. Render with Rscript demo/gallery_clinical.R --theme avm.

14Forest — predictors

JAMA table-forest: text table | forest | estimate column. Arrowheads mark CIs clipped by the axis; box area ∝ N.

fk_forest_general(df,
  cols = list(list(col = "n_label", header = "N"),
              list(col = "p_label", header = "FDR P")),
  x_lab = "Odds ratio (95% CI)", est_col_header = "OR (95% CI)")

15Forest — meta-analysis

Per-study rows + pooled diamond. `label_header` retitles the implicit first column; directional labels sit under the axis.

fk_forest_meta(df,
  cols = list(list(col = "n_label", header = "N")),
  label_header = "Study",
  left_label = "← Negative", right_label = "Variant+ →")

16Kaplan-Meier

Survival curves + risk table. CI ribbons at alpha 0.2, censor ticks dimmed to 0.4 — they annotate, they aren't the estimate.

km <- fk_km_panel(df, "age", "event", "group",
                  xlab = "Age (years)", xlim_max = 60)
fk_save_km_panel("panels/", "fig1d_km", km, w = 5.5, h = 5)

17Regression scatter

Points + fitted line with CI ribbon, by group. Faint points so density reads; `fixed_axis` pins one scale across panels.

fk_regression_scatter(df, x_var = "age", y_var = "vaf",
  color_var = "genotype", fixed_axis = "y",
  fixed_limits = c(0, 8), fixed_breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8))

18Dumbbell prevalence

Paired prevalence per feature, dot size ∝ N, optional 95% CI bars. No connecting line — the dodge does the pairing.

fk_dumbbell(df, feature_col = "feature", group_col = "group",
            value_col = "prevalence", n_col = "n",
            lo_col = "lo", hi_col = "hi")
17/18 panels embedded. Rebuild: python demo/gallery.py --theme avm && Rscript demo/gallery.R --theme avm && Rscript demo/gallery_clinical.R --theme avm && python demo/build_gallery_html.py
